_comment: qeli-ss-plugin standalone CLIENT config (JSON).
Run:  qeli-ss-plugin --config standalone-client.json
No shadowsocks involved: the plugin listens on "listen" and tunnels
every accepted TCP connection over ONE long-lived qeli fake-tls tunnel
to the standalone plugin server (see standalone-server.json).
Key reference:
role      "client" or "server" (default client)
listen    THIS process's listener — point any TCP client here (required).
remote    the standalone plugin server (required).
password  auth secret — REQUIRED; ONE password serves any number of
clients from any hosts (must match the server)
sni       the hostname the fake-TLS ClientHello carries — what a passive
observer (DPI) sees as the destination of an ordinary HTTPS
connection; default www.cloudflare.com; "" omits the SNI
serverkey the server's static PUBLIC key from `qeli-ss-plugin --genkey`
(pinning protects against MITM; remove for trust-on-first-use)
ping      keepalive interval, seconds (0 = off); dead-peer detection is
bounded by ping + 2s
timeout   connect/handshake timeout, seconds
Unknown keys are a config error (a typo must not be silently ignored).
